## 页面标题
- **Study Design – patient’s characteristics, prevalence and incidence**

## 时间线/设计（可见内容）
- 左侧时间点：**Jan 2019**
- 右侧时间点：**Dec 2026**
- **Index date**：*date of the first SSc diagnosis*（首次 SSc 诊断日期）

### 基线期（Baseline period）
- **Baseline period: 12 months**
- 说明：**12 months prior to the index date**（索引日前 12 个月）
- 基线期收集内容（项目符号）：
  - Demographic characteristics
  - Clinical characteristics
  - Patient journey and treatment history
  - HCRU

### 随访期（Follow-up period）
- **Follow-up period: January 1, 2020 - December 31, 2026**
- 随访期收集内容（项目符号）：
  - Incidence rates
  - Patient journey and treatment patterns
  - HCRU and direct medical cost

## 研究人群（Study population）
- Consist of all patients identified as having SSc (both outpatients and inpatients)
- SSc cases will be identified by Chinese medical terms and ICD-10 codes (M34)

## 变量/要素（页面下方三块内容）
### Demographic Characteristics
- Age
- Gender
- Ethnicity
- Insurance type

### Clinical Characteristics
- Associated comorbidities
- Concomitant medications

### Prevalence/Incidence（定义）
- **Prevalence**：total number of prevalent SSc cases who were alive at any time during the calendar year divided by the total insured population on July 1 of that year
- **Yearly incidence**：the number of new SSc cases of each year divided by the total number of at-risk insured individuals in the database at that mid-year (July 1) of each year

## 表格
- 页面中**未见明确表格**（仅有时间线与条目列表/定义框）。

## 决定与行动项
- 页面中**未见“决定/Decision”或“行动项/Action items”**的明确标注与内容。
